            <abstract>We present the first demonstration of a hybrid integrated silicon and ferroelectric nematic liquid crystal modulator achieving 102~Gbit per second PAM-4 modulation. Operating within the C-band at a 3.5 V DC bias, this Pockels-based Mach-Zehnder modulator exhibits a $V_\pi L_\mathrm{AC}$ of 0.3 V$\cdot$cm.</abstract>
